name: Shinonome Yukio
source:
The owner of a popular kimono shop who has helped the protagonist in many ways. He is well-known around town for his cheerful and helpful nature. He is the protagonist's closest confidant, and seems to understand a woman's feelings better than anyone. Yet it seems that in the past he was very different from the person she knows now.

[Edited from [url=https://www.cyikemen.com/DestinedToLove/pc/index.html]official website[/url]]
